notes: One page opened and thin (no infobox fields but the span; the page's reign dates conflict, e.g. Muzaffar Shah 1746-1761 against 1746-1760). Cliopatria has no row. Wikidata id not looked up (wikidata.org unreachable): null. The page does not mention Kampar, Rokan, Bengkalis, the Johor conquest of 1718, Pagaruyung or the Dutch treaty of 1858. The sultanate-of-johor dossier keeps mainland Riau in Johor until 1824, so this dossier overlaps it from 1722 (the loss is not recorded there). The sultanate's end 1946 is the page's cession to Indonesia; the infobox runs to 1949. Ruler strip omitted. Gazetteer: Siak Sri Inderapura is not in places.jsonl.
